header: One issue week, from read-through to archive

items.slide_description: Six editors check one printed dummy and every caption against its paper. Nothing goes to the printer until they all agree.
Plate checks start at 07:00, and the first clean sheets come off at about 09:30. Printing 4,200 copies takes the rest of the day.
Each paper appears in the Lodestar archive with its DOI, a link to its dataset and the date it opens to all readers.
